title: erythroxylum excelsum
intro: Erythroxylum excelsum, commonly known as the sacred tree or sacred cacao tree, is a plant species in the family Erythroxylaceae. It is a tree native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, particularly in the countries of Mexico, Costa Rica, and Ecuador. The health benefits of Erythroxylum excelsum include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
